nodes.title_ko: 생성형 collective 모델과 구조 admission 계약
implementation_steps: Create checked private-field scalar complex cubic model with exact stored-input weight normalization and retained independent initial amplitudes.
Generate reference RHS and certificate expressions from the same immutable model; only optional comparison adapter generates an OdeProblem with real JVP.
Bind mode order, schema, time convention, identity mass, epoch and whole initial box; no sampled-rank admission.

positive: Known generated cubic model retains all initial modes and odd initial moments.
Common linear Dahlquist g=0 boundary handled without claiming nonlinear real-client coverage.
negative: Zero/negative weights, nonfinite parameters, wrong mass, state/radius dimensions, stale epoch, hidden opaque callback mismatch.
Manufactured local-cubic vector and semilinear PDE do not enter as scalar mean feedback.

acceptance: One model defines target and certificate; generic callbacks return UnsupportedModel.
No dummy JVP and no change to existing OdeProblem::new requirements.

nodes.title_ko: kappa=0 finite-window packet와 native total certificate
implementation_steps: Port moment prefix compilation, polynomial waveform Picard and exact causal factorial convolution into binary64 interval-enclosed arithmetic.
Use independent candidate generation and current-input original-model defect certification; enclose tail, rounding and reconstruction.
Add checked resource/cost ledger; do not encode scalar products as JVP calls.
Precompute/recur causal beta weights; adopt LC1 complete output cost and LC2 cache-space contract. Cached prototype is research/promotion_loop12_20261011/causal_weights.py, not native implementation.

positive: Selected exact fixtures from attachment bound native waveform, mean and all reconstructed modes.
Exact coalescence and symmetric weights with nonzero odd initial moment.
Full and compiled unrounded maps agree; native map only needs certified error, not bit parity.
negative: p=0 dropped-tail control refuses when physical bound exceeds budget.
Overflow, subnormal bound collapse, mismatched mode order, asymmetric initial data with odd moments discarded, false certificate Deserialize.

acceptance: Admitted finite-window class only; no full adaptive/global claim.
Online packet Jacobian/JVP/VJP/FD-directional/Krylov/linear-solve counters zero, all other work visible.
Independent Rust review required after implementation.

implementation_steps: Implement outward entire moments for exp(-kappa t) kernel without approximating common fast damping by artificial high-degree Taylor layers.
Bind parameter range/order/precision and switch formula only on verified enclosure criteria.
Retain original initial transient, model tail and phase arithmetic; connect scalar API to packet.

positive: kappa→0 factorial convolution limit with enclosure.
Large kappa*h, small h and mixed j/k orders against selected high-precision/exact identity fixtures.
negative: Use old phi0..phi4 API outside [-600,0] or as arbitrary-order oracle must refuse.
Cancellation branch, moment recurrence instability and unbounded damping uncertainty are not silent successes.

acceptance: Kernel error encloses original damped model at same physical tolerance.
No claim of uniform time complexity in arbitrarily large bit-length kappa.

implementation_steps: Carry mode radii and weighted initial moment enclosures into each subsequent window using approved transfer theorem.
Commit t/state/radii/history only after complete local bound and global budget check; rejected trial retains work but cannot mutate accepted data.
Add global physical norm/time arithmetic/phase ledger and output policy; damping-enabled tests depend on LP03.

positive: Two-plus windows reproduce one-window overlap enclosure under inherited perturbations.
Accepted/rejected/retry sequence preserves accepted state and monotonically increases work.
Mean-only versus all-mode outputs separately reported.
negative: Reset inherited error to zero, stale epoch, rejected candidate mutates start state, missing output mode or stale nu reuse.
Label chained time windows independent homotopy tasks or use embedded error as validated global error.

acceptance: Entire accepted finite trajectory meets physical budget and initial/parameter uncertainty included.
Window-chain implementation does not claim generic RODAS5P tableau identity.

implementation_steps: Generalize to explicit B,C and cheap known linear flow; compile matrix-valued moments, preserve n initial data.
Charge cluster assignment, tensor contractions, cross-cluster feedback and requested outputs.
Use approved rank-r theorem/certificate and actual r/cluster widths; no inference from sampled trajectories.

positive: r=1 reduction agrees with scalar class; r>1 independent channels preserve initial state.
Cluster merge/split keeps original target and exposes truncation cost.
negative: r=n advertised as low rank, missing inter-cluster coupling, sampled rank certificate, discarded transverse modes.

A formula y=Ay+B g(Cy) alone is not a cheap propagator certificate.

positive: Independent original-model and generated-model enclosure agreement over declared domain, not just trajectory sample.
negative: Low-rank RHS sample, conservation law alone, low-dimensional exact trajectory or model name treated as projectability proof.

acceptance: EXISTING_NONLINEAR_REAL_CLIENT remains NOT_ESTABLISHED until evidence exists.
No current real client is invented to satisfy this node.

positive: Selected genuine implicit root varies along path, remains in certified connected tube.
negative: Scalar cubic feedback relabeled implicit closure; pointwise Newton samples treated whole-path branch certificate; fold crossed without witness.

All closure costs and uncertainty included before accuracy/work promotion.

nodes.title_ko: FFT 및 basis 선택의 선택적 가속
implementation_steps: Keep direct convolution strongest small-degree baseline.
If measured workload needs FFT, implement sufficient zero padding and enclosure of transform/arithmetic/alias effects.
Evaluate optional quotient polynomial or Laguerre representations only where exact model and conditioning permit.

positive: Causal convolution coefficients match direct oracle within interval bounds; no periodic boundary introduced.
negative: Circular wraparound, signed cancellation hidden by relative error, asymmetric transform normalization, illegal symmetric-operator admission.

acceptance: Optional acceleration only after end-to-end cost test; FFT is not required to complete LP02/LP04.
No Laguerre dominance or nonlinear iteration parallelism inferred from a polynomial name.

implementation_steps: Freeze exact candidate scope and run selected single-window, damped, multiwindow or rank-r arms only after their relevant dependencies finish.
Compare naive same-map and already-hoisted same-map separately, plus specialized direct ensemble/full solver and appropriate RHS-only UA baseline if actually available.
Record preprocessing, failed trials, native precision, allocations/peak memory, outputs, phase, certificate and fallback; matched physical tolerance.
Same-map n-fold product count requires a declared dense padded schedule or actual per-sweep lengths; arbitrary R_out keeps the shared-output-setup term.

positive: Cost equality against already-hoisted map correctly yields no extra n-factor claim.
Same-map coefficient term ratios agree without being mislabeled wall time.
negative: Weak baseline repeats nonlinear mean n times, ignores output, reports Fraction timings as native, drops failed trials.

acceptance: Count-work, span, elapsed time and physical accuracy have independent outcomes.
Missing baseline is recorded, not synthesized.
Strongest comparator required before production speed promotion.
